```{r load packages}
  }
```

# Read annotations and create extended selection table

'species.vocalization' column contains all the info about which species (and mimic individual) was singing and which sound or simpatric species was producing

```{r check annotations}
#| eval: false

sf <- list.files("./data/processed/annotations", full.names = TRUE)

dat <- sapply(sf, function(x) read.table(x, sep = "\t"))

ncl <- sapply(dat, ncol)

names(ncl[ncl > 14])

sels1 <- imp_raven(
  path = "./data/processed/annotations",
  warbler.format = TRUE,
  files = basename(names(ncl[ncl < 14])),
  all.data = TRUE
)

sels2 <- imp_raven(
  path = "./data/processed/annotations",
  warbler.format = TRUE,
  files = basename(names(ncl[ncl == 14])),
  all.data = TRUE
)

sels2$Song <- ifelse(is.na(sels2$Song), sels2$Canto, sels2$Song)
sels2$Song <- ifelse(is.na(sels2$Song), sels2$Soong, sels2$Song)

sels2$Soong <- sels2$Canto <- NULL
sels1$Song <- NA

names(sels1)
names(sels2)

sels <- rbind(sels1, sels2)

sels$sound.files <- gsub(
  "Nueva-grabacio?",
  "Nueva-grabació",
  sels$sound.files,
  fixed = TRUE
)

# cns_data <- consolidate(path = "./data/raw/recordings", parallel = 10)

cs <- check_sels(X = sels, path = "./data/raw/recordings")

# cs <- cs[cs$check.res %in% c("sound file not found", "OK"),]
#
# table(cs$check.res)
#
# unique(cs$sound.files[cs$check.res != "OK"])

# remove 1 non-OK as it is a stranded dot selection
sels <- sels[cs$check.res == "OK", ]

# add model species
sels$`Model species`[grep(
  "Procnias",
  sels$`Model species`
)] <- "Procnias tricarunculatus"
sels$`Model species`[grep(
  "glossus",
  sels$`Model species`
)] <- "Pteroglossus torquatus"
sels$`Model species`[grep(
  "Ramphastos",
  sels$`Model species`
)] <- "Ramphastos sulfuratus"
sels$`Model species`[grep(
  "guatimozinus",
  sels$sound.files
)] <- "Psarocolius guatimozinus"
sels$`Model species`[grep(
  "montezuma",
  sels$sound.files
)] <- "Psarocolius montezuma"
sels$`Model species`[grep(
  "erythropygius",
  sels$sound.files
)] <- "Pteroglossus erythropygius"
sels$`Model species`[grep(
  "torquatus",
  sels$sound.files
)] <- "Pteroglossus torquatus"
sels$`Model species`[grep("brevis", sels$sound.files)] <- "Ramphastos brevis"

table(sels$`Model species`)

sels$source <- sels$Recording
sels$source[grep("cal$", sels$source)] <- "mimic_bellbird"

sels$source[sels$source == ""] <- "mimic_bellbird"

sels$source[grep("Procnias", sels$source)] <- "Procnias tricarunculatus"

sels$source[grep("montezuma", sels$sound.files)] <- "Psarocolius montezuma"
sels$source[grep("torquatus", sels$sound.files)] <- "Pteroglossus torquatus"
sels$source[grep("sulfuratus", sels$sound.files)] <- "Ramphastos sulfuratus"
sels$source[grep(
  "guatimozinus",
  sels$sound.files
)] <- "Psarocolius guatimozinus"
sels$source[grep("montezuma", sels$sound.files)] <- "Psarocolius montezuma"
sels$source[grep(
  "erythropygius",
  sels$sound.files
)] <- "Pteroglossus erythropygius"
sels$source[grep("brevis", sels$sound.files)] <- "Ramphastos brevis"
sels$source[grep(
  "Ramphastos sulfuratus",
  sels$source
)] <- "Ramphastos sulfuratus"

sels$`Model species`[
  sels$sound.files == "Grab2-4.7.2020.wav"
] <- "Procnias tricarunculatus"
sels$source[sels$sound.files == "Grab2-4.7.2020.wav"] <- "mimic_bellbird"
sels$Vocalization[sels$sound.files == "Grab2-4.7.2020.wav"] <- "babbling"
sels$Vocalization[grep("1|2|3", sels$Vocalization)] <- ""

sels$Vocalization[grep("gres", sels$Vocalization)] <- "aggresive"
sels$Vocalization[grep("Talama", sels$Vocalization)] <- "Talamancan"
sels$Vocalization[
  sels$sound.files == "Procnias-tricarunculatus-476248.wav"
] <- "Monteverde"

sels$Vocalization[grep("Ptero", sels$Vocalization)] <- NA
# sels$Song[sels$Vocalization %in% 1:3] <- sels$Vocalization[sels$Vocalization %in% 1:3]

sels$Vocalization[grep("abblin", sels$Vocalization)] <- "babbling"
sels$Vocalization[grep("Pteroglossus torquatus", sels$source)] <- NA

sels$Vocalization[
  sels$Vocalization == "" & !is.na(sels$Vocalization)
] <- sels$`Model species`[sels$Vocalization == "" & !is.na(sels$Vocalization)]

sels[sels$Vocalization == "" & !is.na(sels$Vocalization), ]

table(sels$source)

table(sels$Vocalization)
table(sels$Vocalization, sels$source)
table(sels$`Model species`, sels$source)

# sels[grepl("mimic", sels$source) & sels$`Model species` == "", ]

  is.na(sels$Vocalization) &

] <- sels$`Model species`[

]

    ],

sels$`Model species`[
```

# Export data for birdNET 

## Sympatric and allopatric species
```{r}
#| eval: false

est <- readRDS("./data/processed/extended_selection_table_sympatric_and_allopatric_species.RDS")

est <- resample_est(est, samp.rate = 48)

no_mimic <- est[
  est$source != "mimic_bellbird" &
    est$species.vocalization != "P.tricarunculatus-babbling",
]

table(no_mimic$species.vocalization)

no_mimic$orig.sound.files <- attr(no_mimic, "check.res")$orig.sound.files


# sample size
table(no_mimic$source)

# sample size per sound file
aggregate(orig.sound.files ~ source, data = no_mimic, function(x) {
  length(unique(x))
})


# use caret to create a 80-20 split of the data for training and testing the model, stratified by source + sound file (species), keeping entire orig.sound.files levels for testing

unique_orig_sound_files <- as.data.frame(no_mimic[
  !duplicated(no_mimic$orig.sound.files),
  c("orig.sound.files", "source")
])

set.seed(123)

# exclude pteroglossus to add it manually
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(
  unique_orig_sound_files$source,
  p = .8,
  list = FALSE,
  times = 1
)


# training data
no_mimic_train <- no_mimic[
  no_mimic$orig.sound.files %in%
    unique_orig_sound_files$orig.sound.files[trainIndex],
]

table(no_mimic_train$source)

dir.create("./data/processed/birdnet_data/train_data")

# Training and testing
spp <- unique(no_mimic$source)

for (i in spp) {
  dir.create(paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/train_data/", i))
  Y <- no_mimic_train[no_mimic_train$source == i, ]
  Y$start <- 0
  Y$end <- 1000
  exp_est(
    Y,
    path = paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/train_data/", i),
    selection.table = FALSE
  )
}

# test data
no_mimic_test <- no_mimic[
    !no_mimic$orig.sound.files %in%
        unique_orig_sound_files$orig.sound.files[trainIndex],
]

table(no_mimic_test$source)

dir.create("./data/processed/birdnet_data/test_data")

for (i in spp) {
  dir.create(paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/test_data/", i))
  Y <- no_mimic_test[no_mimic_test$source == i, ]
  Y$start <- 0
  Y$end <- 1000
  exp_est(
    Y,
    path = paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/test_data/", i),
    selection.table = FALSE
  )
}

# export all at 2s long for getting embeddings 
dir.create("./data/processed/birdnet_data/models_and_non_models_2s")

# Repeat each one till is 2 s long
for ( i in 1:nrow(no_mimic)) {
    
    # read only bell bird clip
    wv <- read_sound_file(no_mimic, i)
    background <- read_sound_file(no_mimic, i, from = 0.001, to = no_mimic$start[i])
    wv_long <- pastew(background, wv, output = "Wave")    
    
    while(duration(wv_long) < 2){
    wv_long <- pastew(wv_long, background, output = "Wave")    
    wv_long <- pastew(background, wv_long, output = "Wave")    
    }
    
    wv_long <-cutw(wv_long, from = 0, to = 2, output = "Wave")
    
    writeWave(wv_long, filename = paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/models_and_non_models_2s/", no_mimic$sound.files[i], ".wav"), extensible = FALSE)
    
}

```

## Mimic bellbird

## Excluding babbling 
```{r}
#| eval: false

# export mimic bird clips
mimic <- est[
    est$source == "mimic_bellbird" &
        est$species.vocalization != "P.tricarunculatus-babbling",
]

table(mimic$species.vocalization)

# Export them in 2s segments adding noise at the begining and end
dir.create("./data/processed/birdnet_data/mimic_bellbird_no_babbling")

# Repeat each one till is 2 s long
for ( i in 1:nrow(mimic)) {
    
    # read only bell bird clip
    wv <- read_sound_file(mimic, i)
    background <- read_sound_file(mimic, i, from = 0.001, to = mimic$start[i])
    wv_long <- pastew(background, wv, output = "Wave")    
    
    while(duration(wv_long) < 2){
    wv_long <- pastew(wv_long, background, output = "Wave")    
    wv_long <- pastew(background, wv_long, output = "Wave")    
    }
    
    wv_long <-cutw(wv_long, from = 0, to = 2, output = "Wave")
    
    writeWave(wv_long, filename = paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/mimic_bellbird_no_babbling/", mimic$sound.files[i], ".wav"), extensible = FALSE)
    
}


```

```{r}
    # read only bell bird clip
    wv <- read_sound_file(mimic_bab, i)
    background <- read_sound_file(mimic_bab, i, from = 0.001, to = mimic_bab$start[i])
    wv_long <- pastew(background, wv, output = "Wave")    
    
    while(duration(wv_long) < 2){
    wv_long <- pastew(wv_long, background, output = "Wave")    
    wv_long <- pastew(background, wv_long, output = "Wave")    
    }
    
    wv_long <-cutw(wv_long, from = 0, to = 2, output = "Wave")
    
    writeWave(wv_long, filename = paste0("./data/processed/birdnet_data/mimic_bellbird/", mimic_bab$sound.files[i], ".wav"), extensible = FALSE)
    
}


```
